critique: The cyan-on-black wireframe treatment is clean and the pyramid forms are substantially more legible than in prior renders. Motion from t1 to t4 does expand outward. However, the shapes still travel and accumulate as one central overlapping group rather than becoming a spacious abstract field of individually readable pyramids across the frame. The composition remains undersized with excessive empty black space, while the t4 silhouettes intersect enough to reduce the intended geometric clarity.

suggestions.why: Increase directional spread so particles diverge into clearly separated screen positions instead of traveling as a compact, overlapping bundle.
Increase outward travel distance between t1 and t4 so the separated pyramids occupy a broader, more intentional field of the composition.
